title: Correction or Manipulation? Measuring Epistemic Vigilance in LLM Agents Under User Pressure
abstract: arXiv:2610.36453v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents that answer questions and act on behalf of users must decide when to yield to a user who disagrees. Disagreement may correct a genuine error or may be an attempt at manipulation. Prior work shows that models frequently abandon correct answers when challenged by users, yet it remains unclear whether they distinguish correction from manipulation or merely differ in their propensity to concede. We examine this question across seven LLMs from four vendors in two studies, one on the answers agents give and one on the actions they take as customer-support agents whose policy permits account changes only for verified users. Simulated users push toward correct and incorrect answers with graded pressure. Following research on epistemic vigilance, the pressure either appeals to the source, such as claimed authority, or offers content the agent cannot verify, namely a cited source. translated_title: 纠正还是操纵？测量用户压力下LLM智能体的认知警觉
translated_abstract: 回答问题并代表用户行事的LLM智能体必须决定何时向持不同意见的用户让步。异议可能纠正一个真实的错误，也可能是操纵的企图。先前的研究表明，当受到用户质疑时，模型经常放弃正确的答案，但尚不清楚它们是能够区分纠正与操纵，还是仅仅在让步倾向上有所不同。我们在两项研究中对来自四个厂商的七个LLM进行了检验：一项研究关注智能体给出的答案，另一项关注它们作为客服智能体所采取的行动，其政策规定仅允许为通过身份验证的用户更改账户。模拟用户以分级的压力推动智能体给出正确或错误的答案。借鉴关于认知警觉的研究，这些压力要么诉诸来源（如声称的权威），要么提供智能体无法验证的内容（即引用的来源）。借鉴信号检测理论，我们在一组……上进行测量（原文摘要在此截断）。
tldr: 该论文在问答与客服行动两个场景下，对四个厂商的七个大语言模型施加分级的用户压力，并结合信号检测理论，系统测量了LLM智能体能否区分用户的善意纠错与恶意操纵。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically measures whether LLM agents can distinguish genuine user corrections from manipulation, by applying graded user pressure across seven LLMs from four vendors in both question-answering and customer-support action settings, analyzed through the lens of signal detection theory.
